RequiredOperations.Name: outputs.wiimote_hook
RequiredOperations.Description: Inspect the Wiimote lightgun output chain: DolphinBar detection, Gunmote status, recoil relay, rumble safety thresholds, double-consumer warnings.

RequiredOperations.Name: components
RequiredOperations.Description: Detected components: Windows, RetroBat, Gunmote, ViGEmBus, DolphinBar, Steam, pinball build, PinballY.

SupportedOperations.Name: controllers.input_profiles
SupportedOperations.Description: List the input profiles (one button layout for the whole cabinet), or one profile with its mapping.

SupportedOperations.Name: controllers.input_apply
SupportedOperations.Description: Write an input profile as a MAME ctrlr file of its own (never a hand-made one); the plan names the RetroBat settings that load it.

SupportedOperations.Name: controllers.wiimote_order
SupportedOperations.Description: Which Wiimote is player 1, 2, ... in Gunmote right now (Gunmote numbers them in the order they connect) and whether that matches the saved binding: Ok, Swapped, Unbound, Unclear, NoGunmote, NoWiimote.

SupportedOperations.Name: controllers.wiimote_bind
SupportedOperations.Description: Save the Wiimote player binding (Bluetooth address -> player): Binding "MAC=1,MAC=2" as chosen, without it the current connection order. The plan shows the binding and a PlanId; -Apply with that PlanId writes only if nothing changed since.

SupportedOperations.Name: outputs.verify_safety
SupportedOperations.Description: Verify output safety: solenoid limits, port conflicts, double output consumers.
